Bokujou Monogatari - Kimi to Sodatsu Shi.name: Harvest Moon DS: Island of Happiness
Bokujou Monogatari - Kimi to Sodatsu Shi.summary: In Harvest Moon: Island of Happiness you develop the island by growing crops and taking care of animals and expanding your farm. The better you do, the more the island will grow, and the more others will start to move onto the island. Though it was not your original dream, now is you chance to create your very own paradise!

Byoutai Seiri DS - Image Dekiru! Shikkan.name: Byoutai Seiri DS: Image Dekiru! Shikkan, Shoujou to Care

Claymore - Gingan no Majo.name: Claymore: Gingan no Majo
Claymore - Gingan no Majo.summary:
The silver eyed witches, a mix between demons and humans are the only ones who can fight against the demons that ravages the land.With the sword Claymore in hand, release the demonic powers in your blood, but stop before this power corrupts the you. An over-dependence on it may turn you into the monster that you are fighting.

The game system is easy to master, with a few taps on the touch screen panel, you can unleash the powers in your blood and launch sure kill attacks.Besides Claire, the heroine, you can to take control of other characters and test out their skills and limits. Sink deeper into the dark, dangerous world of Claymore no longer as a spectator, but as a warrior.

Cookie Shop - Create Your Dream Shop.name: Cookie Shop: Create Your Dream Shop
Cookie Shop - Create Your Dream Shop.summary: Create a custom dessert shop to satisfy the sweet teeth of little dogs and cats in this whimsical business management game for Nintendo DS. You'll help Rose, your dog, oversee the business, making decisions such as which ingredients to purchase, the store's decor and layout, and the right recipes with which to make the most money. More than 45 mini-games are included, allowing you to make ice cream, cut cakes, and perform other shop-related tasks. Interact with 22 characters, choose from more than 50 articles of clothing, and participate in 150 events in your quest to become the most successful shop in Sweet City.

Hello Kitty - Daily.name: Hello Kitty Daily
Hello Kitty - Daily.summary:
Your Personal Ds Assistant

Discover how to use your Nintendo DS in a whole new way with the adorable Hello Kitty!

Join the iconic feline as you track your daily activities, update your friend directory, write in your diary and more.

Let Hello Kitty Daily manage your busy life and stay organized in style!

Mr. Driller - Drill Spirits.name: Mr. Driller: Drill Spirits
Mr. Driller - Drill Spirits.summary: Mr. Driller, experienced with the drill, much use his abilities to dig beneath the Earth's crust in a race to the finish in order to save the day. Dangerous traps await as you dig through the puzzle layout to the goal, and be careful of Mr. Driller's air supply which can run out quickly. Find the right powerups to increase abilities and air supply while fighting the time clock.

Pokemon Dash.name: Pokémon Dash
Pokemon Dash.summary: In Pokémon Dash, you'll control Pikachu and race against other Pokémon. Use the DS's touch screen to adjust Pikachu's direction and speed. Off the course, Pikachu can cross water terrain by riding on Lapras' back and fly using a hot-air balloon.

Sekaiju no Meikyuu II - Shoou no Seihai.name: Etrian Odyssey II: Heroes of Lagaard
Sekaiju no Meikyuu II - Shoou no Seihai.summary: In the Grand Duchy of High Lagaard, it is said that the Duke is descended from inhabitants of a castle in the sky. When an unforeseen crisis befalls the nation, it is decreed that the first explorer to retrieve the Grail of Kings from that mythical floating palace will be rewarded with wealth and fame beyond imagining. Enter the central city of Lagaard and begin your journey to the clouds!

Shaun White Snowboarding.name: Shaun White Snowboarding
Shaun White Snowboarding.summary:
Enter a snowboarding world of total freedom. You can create your own experience in this game, and choose when, where, how and with whom you want to ride.
Developed in close collaboration with Olympic Gold Medalist Shaun White – the most successful snowboarder in the history of the sport – Shaun White Snowboarding is the next-gen game that redefines the action sports genre.

Open-world mountains: Choose how you ride in open-world mountains accross the globe. Conquer the extreme peak conditions, create your own paths in the back country, or compete with fellow riders in the terrain park.
Your friends are always around: Play in a world where your friends are always around. Do you own runs on mountains populated by real gamers, or join your friends for a quick session from anywhere in the mountains.
More than just snowboarding: Have fun with your friends on and off the board: Throw snowballs, hike to access secret spots, film your friends doing crazy tricks. You can also upload your videos online to share with the world.
Ride your way: Express yourself through tricks, riding styles, and highly customizable avatars both in single-player and in the online world. Use the intuitive dual analog control to pull off a huge variety of tricks that express your style.

Yatterman DS 2 - Bikkuri Dokkiri Animal.name: Yatterman DS 2: Bikkuri Dokkiri Animal Daibouken
Yatterman DS 2 - Bikkuri Dokkiri Animal.summary: Yatterman DS 2: Bikkuridokkiri Animal Daibouken is an Action game, developed and published by Takara Tomy, which was released in Japan in 2008.
